question: Which state appointed Robin Uthappa as brand ambassador for the Brain Health Initiative in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Robin Uthappa** was appointed as the** brand ambassador** for the **Brain Health Initiative** in **2022** by the state of **Karnataka.**
 
• The **Brain Health Initiative** is a program aimed at promoting **mental health **and well-being in the state.
 
• Robin Uthappa is a well-known **cricketer** who has played for the Indian national team and the Karnataka state team.
 
• As a brand ambassador, Uthappa will be expected to promote the Brain Health Initiative and raise awareness about the** importance of mental health.**
